After searching for a better way to find packages, I started using packer as a means to search (and install) packages from the community and the AUR at the same time. It uses PACMAN flags so you really dont have to learn something completely new. Thanks to bruenig and his post on the arch linux forums for his post on the matter! For instance, "packer -Ss package or key words" will net you the core/community packages first, followed by packages from the AUR. Once you find the package you want, or already know it, type "packer -S packagename". If you need sudo it'll ask you after. * Super Easy *.
